title: interface.v2
$comment: Reader-derived, read-only comparison of the written function interfaces between two recorded cutoffs of one capture session (FUNCTION-CHANGES.md). No log event, seq or persisted index is created. Endpoints are recorded states, never the live filesystem or Git. Shared types, effects and behaviour are not analyzed. Cross-field invariants that src/schema.ts cannot express (if/else, maxItems, additionalProperties, nullable type arrays) are enforced by tools/interface-v2-contract.ts.

session_id.$comment: Capture scope (which worktree is watched), never authorship. A comparison never spans sessions.

status.$comment: ready: every returned file is ready or identical (including an empty page); not a claim of complete inventory, history or semantics. partial: at least one returned file has another status. skipped: no file could start; files is empty and the cursor does not move.

fallback_reason.$comment: Present exactly when status is skipped.

scope.$comment: Only paths recorded in this session are compared (F2-A). Never a complete repository inventory.

baseline_completed_seq.$comment: seq of capture.baseline.completed when it is at or before after_seq, else null. A value greater than before_seq means the baseline was still running at the before cutoff.

unknown_scopes.$comment: From capture.baseline.completed, ordered by UTF-16 code unit; empty when the baseline is not complete by after_seq.

unknown_scopes_complete.$comment: false when entries were omitted by the shared 64 KiB metadata budget; the full list is on the event stream.

policy_exclusions.$comment: Static capture policy, always exactly ["store-directory", ".git", "symlinks"] (checked in code; src/schema.ts const is not deep): these targets are never read, and the baseline records no event for them.

analysis.$comment: Decisions F3-A and F4-A. Analyzing any of these is a new projection version.

gaps.$comment: Every capture.gap at or before after_seq, ordered by seq, subject to the shared 64 KiB metadata budget.

files.$comment: Ordered by path, by exact UTF-16 code unit. identical results appear only with include_identical=true.

complete.$comment: true only on the last page. Loaded totals are partial until then.

next_after_path.$comment: Exclusive cursor for the next request. null when complete. On a skipped page it repeats the request's after_path (null when none), so the cursor does not move.

cutoff.$comment: Decimal string, arbitrary precision. 0 means the empty recorded prefix, not an empty repository.

snapshot.$comment: The recorded snapshot tag, identical to the file.changed / file.baselined event shape.

record_seq.$comment: The event that recorded this state. For the first-change predecessor rule it is the later file.changed, with field before, so the response never claims the state was recorded by before_seq.

field.$comment: snapshot: file.baselined. before/after: that side of a file.changed.

observation.$comment: Present exactly when the record is a file.changed.

gap_ref.$comment: Copied from a reconciliation record. Never a claim that the outage's intermediate edits were recovered.

kind.$comment: Projection-derived: the path has no record at or before before_seq and the first-change predecessor rule does not apply. There is no provenance because no such record exists.

state.$comment: Each side reports its own extraction state even when its reason lost status precedence. identical content is notEvaluated (no parse happened).

reason.$comment: Present exactly for incomplete and unavailable, e.g. parse-error, blob-missing, unknown-boundary, oversize.

after.$comment: Always recorded: a listed path has a record at or before after_seq.

language.$comment: Plain string, never an enum. null exactly when no language module exists for the path, whatever the status.

language_version.$comment: e.g. typescript.v2, swift.v1. null exactly when language is null.

status.$comment: First established condition wins (FUNCTION-CHANGES.md §4.4): identical, before/after incomplete, duplicate-declaration, ambiguous-correspondence, before/after unavailable, unsupported, too-large, timeout/cancelled, ready.

fallback_reason.$comment: Present exactly for incomplete, unavailable, unsupported and skipped. Absent for identical and ready.

changes.$comment: Non-empty only when status is ready (DA-3, per file). Ordered removed, signatureChanged, added, then by the D8 tuple.

parameters.$comment: Rows with a before side in before-position order, then added rows in after-position order. A parameter pairs only by a written local name occurring exactly once on each side.

result.$comment: null when neither side has a result slot (a TypeScript constructor).

header.$comment: Every part of the written header not covered by parameters, result or throws.

identity.$comment: A matching key scoped to the path, not proof of rename continuity. No overload ordinal or line number.

span.$comment: [byte_start, byte_end) over the raw UTF-8 bytes of that side's endpoint blob.

op.$comment: Sides carry normalized token text. equal: both sides present and identical. added: before null. removed: after null. changed: both present and different.

oneOf.$comment: written: the annotation in the source (a TypeScript annotation spelled unknown is written). implicit: defined by the language, e.g. Swift Void for an omitted return clause.
Nothing is written and the type would be inferred. Extraction is complete; the type is unknown.

label.$comment: A separately written Swift argument label (including _). null when none is written, and always null in TypeScript.

name.$comment: The written local name, or the whole written destructuring pattern.

binding.$comment: pattern and wildcard (Swift _) have no pairing key and are never paired.

default.$comment: Written default expression syntax, or null.

modifiers.$comment: As written, e.g. Swift inout, TypeScript readonly/public parameter properties.

failable.$comment: Swift init? / init!; null for a non-failable init. -> Self is never fabricated.

mode.$comment: notExpressible: TypeScript has no throws clause; never read as does-not-throw. none: Swift with no throws clause. throws/rethrows: as written; a declared throws does not mean the function actually throws.

type.$comment: Swift typed throws(E) only, when the pinned grammar parses it clean.

modifiers.$comment: Written order, e.g. export, async, static, public, mutating.
